title.english: Where the Map Has No Mountains

pairs.target: nà zhāng tú de biānyuán méiyǒu huà shān . tǎ wéi tì nài lěi bǎ chāo hǎo de dìmíng pái zài cháng zhuōshàng , yìzhí rěnbúzhù kàn .
pairs.english: There were no mountains drawn at the map's edge. Arranging copied place names on the long table for Nerai, Tavi couldn't stop looking.
pairs.hanzi:
那张图的边缘没有画山。
塔维替奈蕾把抄好的地名排在长桌上，一直忍不住看。

pairs.target: guòqù tā jiàn de tú , búshì dàolù zǒu dào biānshàng , jiùshì yí chóngchóng děng gāo de xiàn bǎ kòngbái jǐmǎn .
pairs.english: In the maps he had seen before, either roads reached the edge or layer upon layer of contour lines crowded out the blank space.
pairs.hanzi: 过去他见的图，不是道路走到边上，就是一重重等高的线把空白挤满。

pairs.target: zhè zhāng bùtóng , shān dào zhōngduàn biàn xī le , xià tóu shì yí dàpiàn bèi shuǐ huàkāi de píngdì , jǐtiáo lù duàn zài zhǐbiān , pángbiān zhī xiě le dào cǐ wèichá .
pairs.english: This one was different. The mountains thinned halfway across; below lay a broad plain cut by water. Several roads broke off at the paper's edge, marked only: surveyed no farther.
pairs.hanzi: 这张不同，山到中段便稀了，下头是一大片被水划开的平地，几条路断在纸边，旁边只写了到此未查。

pairs.target: " búshì dào cǐ méi lù . " nài lěi cóng tā jiān hòu shuō . tā huítóu , fāxiàn tā shǒulǐ duān zhe liǎngwǎn tāng , yìwǎn dìgěi zìjǐ , yìwǎn fàngzài duìmiàn nàge mòshēng nǚrén gēnqián .
pairs.english: “Not: roads go no farther,” Nerai said behind his shoulder. He turned to find her carrying two bowls of soup, handing him one and putting the other before the unfamiliar woman opposite.
pairs.hanzi:
“不是到此没路。”奈蕾从他肩后说。
他回头，发现她手里端着两碗汤，一碗递给自己，一碗放在对面那个陌生女人跟前。

pairs.target: nǚrén zhèngzài cóng xuēzǐ lǐ dǎo shā , dǎo chūlái de dōngxī hěn xì , yánsè piān hóng , bú xiàng shí zhuó dàihuí de ní .
pairs.english: The woman was emptying sand from her boot, fine and reddish, unlike the mud brought back from Stonewash.
pairs.hanzi: 女人正在从靴子里倒砂，倒出来的东西很细，颜色偏红，不像石濯带回的泥。

pairs.target: tā jiào cén líng , shì jīnwǎn xiǎo jiǎng huì de kèrén , yě shì yuèjiè kè . yāo biān de bái pái yǒu liǎngdào kèhén , pái jiǎo quē le yìxiǎopiàn , yòng xì tóngsī chánzhù . yǒurén wèn guò néng bunéng bǔ , tā shuō bǔ le yě dǎngbúzhù xiàhuí kē , méi zài zhǎnkāi jiǎng .
pairs.english: Her name was Cenling, tonight's guest speaker and an Outrider. The white tally at her waist had two notches, one corner chipped and bound with fine copper wire. Asked whether it could be repaired, she said that wouldn't prevent the next knock, and left it there.
pairs.hanzi: 她叫岑菱，是今晚小讲会的客人，也是越界客。腰边的白牌有两道刻痕，牌角缺了一小片，用细铜丝缠住。有人问过能不能补，她说补了也挡不住下回磕，没再展开讲。

pairs.target: tā jiē tāng qián xiān xǐshǒu , zhǐjié yǒu yídào jié hǎo de jiù kǒuzǐ . tǎ wéi běnlái xiǎng wèn shāng zěnme lái de , tā què xiān wèn tā zhuōshàng nà jǐgè zì shì shuí chāo de , chēngzàn qízhōng yígè dìmíng zhōngyú méi bèi gǎichéng tīng shàngqù xiàng cài de míngzì .
pairs.english: She washed before taking the soup; an old cut had healed over her knuckle. Tavi meant to ask about the injury, but she first asked who had copied the words on the table, praising a place name for finally not being turned into something sounding like a vegetable.
pairs.hanzi: 她接汤前先洗手，指节有一道结好的旧口子。塔维本来想问伤怎么来的，她却先问他桌上那几个字是谁抄的，称赞其中一个地名终于没被改成听上去像菜的名字。

pairs.target: nài lěi xiào , shuō shàng yícì nà zhāng jiùshì tā zìjǐ bàocuò yīn . wǎnfàn hòu , lái tīng de rén bǎ zhuōzi wéi le liǎngcéng , hòupái yǒu xuéshēng , yě yǒu lái jiè tú de chēxíng huǒjì .
pairs.english: Nerai laughed: last time she had given the wrong pronunciation herself. After supper the listeners stood two deep around the table, students at the back alongside a transport-company worker borrowing a map.
pairs.hanzi:
奈蕾笑，说上一次那张就是她自己报错音。
晚饭后，来听的人把桌子围了两层，后排有学生，也有来借图的车行伙计。

pairs.target: cén líng méiyǒu xiān jiǎng wēixiǎn , cóng dài lǐ náchū yígè quántou dà de kōngké , hèsè , biānshàng cháng zhe sānpiàn wān chì . tā wǎng kōngzhōng qīngqīng yì pāo , nà dōngxī biàn dǎzhe xuán luòdào tāngwǎn pángbiān , xiǎnxiē yòu jiànshī dìtú .
pairs.english: Cenling didn't start with danger. She took a fist-sized hollow shell from her bag, brown with three curved wings. Tossed gently upward, it spun down beside the soup bowl, nearly splashing the map again.
pairs.hanzi: 岑菱没有先讲危险，从袋里拿出一个拳头大的空壳，褐色，边上长着三片弯翅。她往空中轻轻一抛，那东西便打着旋落到汤碗旁边，险些又溅湿地图。

pairs.target: " zǐ ké . búshì chuán , yě bùchī . " tǎ wéi tuōqǐlái , cái fāxiàn tā qīng dé bú xiàng yǒu nàyàng dà .
pairs.english: “A seed husk. Not a boat, and not for eating.” Tavi lifted it, discovering it was impossibly light for its size.
pairs.hanzi:
“籽壳。不是船，也不吃。”
塔维托起来，才发现它轻得不像有那样大。

pairs.target: cén líng shuō cháng tā de cǎo bǐ wūdǐng hái gāo , hébiān rén jiāng gān jīng pōukāi dā zhē péng , fēngjì guòqù , chéngpiàn de zǐ ké huì cóng qiǎnshuǐ shàng zhuǎnguò qù . tā gěi nà piàn zhù qū huà lù , zū guò yíduàn péng yán , měiwǎn dōu tīngjiàn yǒurén bǎ luò zài dǐngshàng de ké sǎo xiàlái .
pairs.english: Cenling said its grass grew taller than rooftops. Riverside people split the dry stems for shelters; after the wind season, sheets of husks spun over the shallows. Mapping paths for that settlement, she had rented space under an awning, hearing someone sweep fallen husks off the roof every night.
pairs.hanzi: 岑菱说长它的草比屋顶还高，河边人将干茎剖开搭遮棚，风季过去，成片的籽壳会从浅水上转过去。她给那片住区画路，租过一段棚檐，每晚都听见有人把落在顶上的壳扫下来。

pairs.target: yǒurén wèn nàlǐ wèishénme bù bān dào shānshàng . " tāmen wèn guò wǒ , wèishénme nǐmen shénme dōu yào wǎng shàng bèi . " wūlǐ xiào le yízhèn .
pairs.english: Someone asked why people there didn't move to the mountains. “They asked me why you carry absolutely everything uphill.” Laughter filled the room for a while.
pairs.hanzi:
有人问那里为什么不搬到山上。
“他们问过我，为什么你们什么都要往上背。”
屋里笑了一阵。

pairs.target: cén líng tānkāi lìng yìzhāng xiǎo tú , zhǐ gěi tāmen kàn gāodì , jiù dī hé néng zhǎngshuǐ de wā chù . tā shuō yǒuxiē dìfāng yào qiān , yǒuxiē yǐjīng zhù le jǐdàirén , bùnéng zhī kàn zhǐ shàng méiyǒu huà shān , jiù tì měijiā juédìng gāi bān .
pairs.english: Cenling spread another small map, showing higher ground, old embankments and flood-prone hollows. Some places needed moving, she said; others had been home for generations. A lack of drawn mountains didn't entitle you to decide every household must move.
pairs.hanzi: 岑菱摊开另一张小图，指给他们看高地、旧堤和能涨水的洼处。她说有些地方要迁，有些已经住了几代人，不能只看纸上没有画山，就替每家决定该搬。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi mō zhe zǐ ké de chì biān , xiǎngqǐ zìjǐ zuìchū yǐwéi shān wài chùchù dōu shì huāngdì . xiànzài lián huāngdì liǎnggè zì , yě dé xiān wèn shì nǎ yípiàn .
pairs.english: Feeling the husk's wing edge, Tavi remembered first thinking everywhere beyond the mountains was wasteland. Now even that word required asking which patch.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维摸着籽壳的翅边，想起自己最初以为山外处处都是荒地。现在连荒地两个字，也得先问是哪一片。

pairs.target: chēxíng huǒjì guānxīn nàtiáo héng guòqù de xiàn néng bunéng yùnhuò . cén líng shuō tā zhècì shòutuō chá de shì bùxíng jiēdiǎn hé yǔjì zhùchù , chēqiáo de chéngzhòng méicè .
pairs.english: The transport worker wanted to know whether the crossing line could carry freight. Cenling said her commission covered pedestrian connections and wet-season lodging; she hadn't tested the road bridge's load capacity.
pairs.hanzi: 车行伙计关心那条横过去的线能不能运货。岑菱说她这次受托查的是步行接点和雨季住处，车桥的承重没测。

pairs.target: huǒjì yǒuxiē shīwàng , wèn huā zhème duō qián , zěnme bù yìqǐ cè . nài lěi bǎ wǎn tuī yuǎn yìdiǎn , shuō dài rén , dài zhòngwù , jiè chǎngdì , quán búshì zài zhǐ shàng tiān yìháng .
pairs.english: Disappointed, the worker asked why, with so much money spent, they hadn't tested it too. Nerai pushed her bowl away: bringing people, heavy loads and borrowing a site wasn't merely adding a line on paper.
pairs.hanzi:
伙计有些失望，问花这么多钱，怎么不一起测。
奈蕾把碗推远一点，说带人、带重物、借场地，全不是在纸上添一行。

pairs.target: tā shuō dé bù huǎnhé , cén líng què bǎishǒu , shuō tā wèn dé méicuò , chūqián de rén yě zhèyàng wèn guò , zìjǐ huílái hái dé qù jiěshì .
pairs.english: Her tone wasn't gentle, but Cenling waved a hand: his question was fair, the funders had asked the same, and she still had to explain on her return.
pairs.hanzi: 她说得不缓和，岑菱却摆手，说他问得没错，出钱的人也这样问过，自己回来还得去解释。

pairs.target: " háiyǒu rén zhǐyào wǒ dài sānzhòng shùzhī . " tā shuō , " nà yítàng , wǒ jiù búhuì zài tú shàng tì nǐmen bǎ měi tiáo xiàngzi huà quán . "
pairs.english: “Some people only want three kinds of resin from me,” she said. “On that trip I won't map every lane for you.”
pairs.hanzi: “还有人只要我带三种树脂。”她说，“那一趟，我就不会在图上替你们把每条巷子画全。”

pairs.target: tā bǎ jǐzhāng tú dié kāi , tóng yípiàn ànbiān , yìzhāng yǒu zhùhù , yìzhāng zhī biāo shuǐwèi , lìng yìzhāng lián shuǐ dōu méi huà wán .
pairs.english: She spread several maps in overlapping layers: the same bank, one showing households, another only water levels, another not even finishing the water.
pairs.hanzi: 她把几张图叠开，同一片岸边，一张有住户，一张只标水位，另一张连水都没画完。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kànzhe nàxiē bǐcǐ duì bùqí de biān , hūrán míngbái zìjǐ wèishénme lǎo juéde tú wài yídìng háiyǒu yìcéng dōngxī .
pairs.english: Looking at edges that didn't match each other, Tavi suddenly understood why he always felt there must be another layer beyond the map.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看着那些彼此对不齐的边，忽然明白自己为什么老觉得图外一定还有一层东西。

pairs.target: sànhuì hòu , tā bāng zhe shōu dèngzǐ , zhídào chēxíng huǒjì yě zǒu le , cái gàosù nài lěi zìjǐ yòu yào qù wèn yú wān de chuán .
pairs.english: After the gathering he helped stack stools, waiting until the transport worker had left before telling Nerai he was going to ask again about boats to Elmbay.
pairs.hanzi: 散会后，他帮着收凳子，直到车行伙计也走了，才告诉奈蕾自己又要去问榆湾的船。

pairs.target: tā yǐ kànguò fú lán de chāo xìn , zhīdào jiù dìzhǐ de lái chù ; tā bǎ wū yà xīn xìn shuō qīng , yòu shuō zhèhuí zhī xiān dǎtīng xiànxíng kè lù .
pairs.english: She had read the copy of Fulan's letter and knew the old address's source; he explained Wuya's new letter, saying this time he was only checking current passenger routes first.
pairs.hanzi: 她已看过芙兰的抄信，知道旧地址的来处；他把乌娅新信说清，又说这回只先打听现行客路。

pairs.target: nài lěi wèn tā xiǎng zài nàlǐ kàn shénme . tā dá le huòchǎng , suíhòu yòu shuō xiǎng kànkàn jiē , fángzi , háiyǒu rén dàodǐ zěnyàng guòrìzi . huà chūkǒu yǒuxiē bùhǎoyìsi , xiàng zìjǐ ná zhèngshì zuò jièkǒu , tān zhe wán .
pairs.english: Nerai asked what he wanted to see there. He named the freight yard, then streets and houses and how people actually lived. He felt embarrassed saying it, as if using serious business as an excuse to enjoy himself.
pairs.hanzi:
奈蕾问他想在那里看什么。
他答了货场，随后又说想看看街、房子，还有人到底怎样过日子。话出口有些不好意思，像自己拿正事作借口，贪着玩。

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu xiào , zhī wèn tā huì buhuì liú yìtiān shénme dōu méi zhǎodào de kòngdāng . tǎ wéi shuō jiǎ zǒnggòng liùtiān , bù yídìng gòu . tā biàn jiào tā xiān wèn bāncì , bié zài zhuōbiān yìng jǐchū dìqītiān .
pairs.english: She didn't laugh, only asked whether he'd leave a day for finding nothing. Tavi said the holiday was six days in all and might not suffice. She told him to check sailings first, not squeeze a seventh day out of a table.
pairs.hanzi: 她没有笑，只问他会不会留一天什么都没找到的空当。塔维说假总共六天，不一定够。她便叫他先问班次，别在桌边硬挤出第七天。

pairs.target: cén líng bèi hǎo dàizǐ , yào cóng hòumén zǒu . jiàn tǎ wéi réng tuō zhe zǐ ké , tā shuō kěyǐ liúgěi tā , lǐmiàn yǐ kōng , búhuì zhǎng chū yìjiān péng .
pairs.english: Cenling shouldered her bag to leave by the back door. Seeing Tavi still holding the husk, she said he could keep it: it was empty and wouldn't grow him a shelter.
pairs.hanzi: 岑菱背好袋子，要从后门走。见塔维仍托着籽壳，她说可以留给他，里面已空，不会长出一间棚。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi hái méi kāikǒu dàoxiè , tā yòu zhéhuílái , jiāng yā zài ké dǐ de yìxiǎopiàn huàtúzhǐ chōuzǒu . " zhège dé hái wǒ . wǒ hái méi lǐngdào qián . "
pairs.english: Before Tavi could thank her, she turned back and pulled a small drawing slip from beneath the husk. “This comes back to me. I haven't been paid yet.”
pairs.hanzi:
塔维还没开口道谢，她又折回来，将压在壳底的一小片画图纸抽走。
“这个得还我。我还没领到钱。”

pairs.target: nài lěi xiào dé tāngsháo pèng zài wǎn yán shàng . tǎ wéi tuō zhe nà jiàn qīng dé chūqí de dōngxī , yìshí jìng bùgǎn bǎshǒu hélǒng .
pairs.english: Nerai laughed so hard her spoon knocked the bowl's rim. Holding that astonishingly light thing, Tavi briefly dared not close his hand.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾笑得汤勺碰在碗沿上。塔维托着那件轻得出奇的东西，一时竟不敢把手合拢。
